<h2>Validate an sjSDM Artifact Payload</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Validates the exact registered payload names, container types, and
duplicate rows for one v2 artifact type.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_sjsdm_artifact_payload(
  artifact_type = NULL,
  payload = NULL,
  list_table_contracts = base::list()
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="artifact_type">artifact_type</code></td>
<td>
<p>Registered artifact type.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="payload">payload</code></td>
<td>
<p>Named payload list.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="list_table_contracts">list_table_contracts</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional named list of exact table contracts. Each contract may define
'columns', 'types', 'keys', 'statuses', and 'n_rows'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Invisible 'TRUE'; invalid payloads abort.
</p>

</main>
